doc: Task 16a: an approved job's ready task gets a worker: a worktree <repo>/.claude/worktrees/<job>-<n> on job/<job>-<n>, a session on the task's profile with the role worker, job and task set, started in that tree (its lock and sandbox as any worker's), the task claimed by the session and the first base kept. A blocked task gets none; the second task waits for the first. The worker's mock never ends its turn (silent), so the hooks of Task 16b do not remind it or card it.

args: mkdir -p $ROOT/repo && cd $ROOT/repo && git init -q && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -q --allow-empty -m init
